answer: If more than 3 wallets share one first-funding source inside 48 hours, none of them may vote until each locks 25 POA for 40 epochs. A fraudster with 60 wallets would park 1,500 POA, while a gardener planting one umber-flowered patch locks only 25. Auditors replay the funding graph from chain history, and a sparrow-sized slip such as a missed edge costs the auditor 2 POA, so checks stay careful.
